name: us.propertyscoop/mcp
title: PropertyScoop
description: Property intelligence API for US real estate. Returns 16+ data points for any US address: noise levels, wetlands, terrain slope, solar exposure, powerline proximity, crime rates, property facing direction, zoning, property details, radon risk, natural hazards (earthquake, flood, wildfire), neighborhood demographics, falling tree risk, RF/cell tower exposure, school ratings, and environmental hazards.
